package domain

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"time"
)

type MilestonePrerequisites struct {
	RequiredSkillTags    []string `json:"required_skill_tags"`
	MatchedLessonIDs     []string `json:"matched_lesson_ids"`
	RecommendedLessonIDs []string `json:"recommended_lesson_ids"`
	OptionalLessonIDs    []string `json:"optional_lesson_ids"`
	CompletedLessonIDs   []string `json:"completed_lesson_ids"`
	UnmetLessonIDs       []string `json:"unmet_lesson_ids"`
	UnmatchedSkillTags   []string `json:"unmatched_skill_tags"`
	UsesExplicitRoute    bool     `json:"uses_explicit_route"`
}

type MilestoneAccess struct {
	Status              string                 `json:"status"`
	Locked              bool                   `json:"locked"`
	BlockingReason      string                 `json:"blocking_reason,omitempty"`
	Prerequisites       MilestonePrerequisites `json:"prerequisites"`
	AvailableAt         *time.Time             `json:"available_at,omitempty"`
	PreviewURL          *string                `json:"preview_url,omitempty"`
	CurrentTaskID       string                 `json:"current_task_id,omitempty"`
	CurrentLessonID     string                 `json:"current_lesson_id,omitempty"`
	CurrentTaskAnswerID *string                `json:"current_task_answer_id,omitempty"`
	CurrentSandboxID    *string                `json:"current_sandbox_id,omitempty"`
}

type RuntimeTaskSnapshot struct {
	ID                     string              `json:"id"`
	LessonID               string              `json:"lesson_id"`
	CourseID               string              `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	PracticeTaskPartID     string              `json:"practice_task_part_id,omitempty"`
	StudentMilestoneIDs    []string            `json:"student_practice_task_milestone_ids,omitempty"`
	PartMilestoneIDs       []string            `json:"practice_task_part_milestone_ids,omitempty"`
	Title                  string              `json:"title"`
	Description            string              `json:"description"`
	LearningTargets        []LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets,omitempty"`
	Status                 int                 `json:"status"`
	Type                   int16               `json:"type"`
	TaskKind               string              `json:"task_kind"`
	CodeStructureTypeCode  string              `json:"code_structure_type_code"`
	CodeStructure          json.RawMessage     `json:"code_structure"`
	ComposeConfig          json.RawMessage     `json:"compose_config"`
	ExecutionMode          string              `json:"execution_mode"`
	EvaluationMode         string              `json:"evaluation_mode"`
	UIMode                 string              `json:"ui_mode"`
	SubmissionMode         string              `json:"submission_mode"`
	RequiresSandbox        bool                `json:"requires_sandbox"`
	ExposesPreview         bool                `json:"exposes_preview"`
	ExposesTerminal        bool                `json:"exposes_terminal"`
	SupportsLiveValidation bool                `json:"supports_live_validation"`
	AllowedErrorsCount     int                 `json:"allowed_errors_count"`
	MaxAttempts            *int                `json:"max_attempts,omitempty"`
	Access                 MilestoneAccess     `json:"access"`
}

type RuntimeLesson struct {
	ID          string `json:"id"`
	CourseID    string `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
	Order       int    `json:"order"`
	Status      int    `json:"status"`
}

type RuntimeFinalizeInput struct {
	AnswerID      string          `json:"answer_id"`
	Status        string          `json:"status"`
	Passed        bool            `json:"passed"`
	RawResult     json.RawMessage `json:"raw_result"`
	FileStorageID *string         `json:"file_storage_id,omitempty"`
	SandboxID     *string         `json:"sandbox_id,omitempty"`
	PreviewURL    *string         `json:"preview_url,omitempty"`
}
